verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe scheduling ("Run Claude on a schedule... overnight CI failure analysis, weekly dependency audits"), trigger-based automation (Slack mentions, GitHub PR review), and long-running/remote sessions, which directly map to the always-on agent story. However, community reports of unreliable self-verification, degrading output quality, and failure to safely iterate autonomously suggest the autonomous maintenance/fix capability is not fully dependable in practice.
